issue.body:
- NewAddress with empty list (addrConn with an empty address list)
 - NewServiceConfig to switch balancer before the first balancer is built

updates #1683

This makes NewSubConn() with empty list return an error, and makes UpdateAddress() with empty list tear the addrConn down. The SubConn won't be usable after this.
Eventually we want to make the SubConn with empty address list stay in TransientFailure but still usable, and balancer still can update this SubConn's address. This will be done in a follow-up PR.

body:
I created a PR for the two problems you mentioned: https://github.com/grpc/grpc-go/pull/1684
Can you give it a try? Thanks!
both issues are fixed by the PR. thanks!

The fix was merged. But we want to make the behavior more consistent.

The change makes `NewSubConn()` with empty list return an error, and makes `UpdateAddress()` with empty list tear the addrConn down. The SubConn won't be usable after this.

Eventually we want to make the SubConn with empty address list stay in TransientFailure but still usable, and balancer still can update this SubConn's address.

This will be done in a follow-up PR. And let's keep this issue open to track this.

issue.body:
If connecting to an address returns a non-temporary error, this address will be removed from the list of addresses that will be retried on.
When there's no more address to retry, that addrConn will go to TransientError and then will be torn down (Shutdown).

This was part of #1657 and got reverted to avoid conflict with other changes.

Also it should be OK to call `newAddrConn()` or to update ac.addrs to empty list now. The ac with no connect-able addresses will be torn down.

fixes #1683
